no_new_object_family: Replay claims are emitted as the existing public ReplayReceipt@1.0.0 family; grade and mechanism travel as explicit extra semantic material inside that accepted family. No duplicate vocabulary was invented.

grades.meaning: A narrated or stored explanation of what a product was. Demonstrates nothing about recomputation.
A stored receipt or product deserialized and re-verified for internal integrity. Demonstrates serialization fidelity only.
A fresh process reconstructs the product through the accepted path. Asserting this grade requires a fresh-process accepted-producer mechanism.
A fresh process re-executes the claimed producer/composition path from exact retained determinants and the product identity reproduces exactly.

fail_closed_law.grade_may_not_exceed_mechanism: A claim whose declared grade is stronger than its mechanism can support raises ReplayGradeOverclaim (REPLAY_GRADE_OVERCLAIM).
fail_closed_law.missing_determinant_or_authority: An empty retained_determinant_refs or authority_refs raises MissingExactDeterminant (MISSING_EXACT_DETERMINANT) rather than silently downgrading the grade.
fail_closed_law.identity_mismatch_does_not_downgrade: A claim whose observed identity differs from the expected identity fails closed; it is never silently re-labelled at a weaker grade while still claiming the stronger one.

hostiles_executed.hostile: stored JSON/receipt explanation must not qualify as fresh recomputation
serialization/deserialization alone must not qualify as fresh empirical recomputation
missing exact determinant or authority must fail closed rather than silently downgrade
a stronger claim whose identity does not reproduce must fail, not downgrade
the fresh runner must recompute rather than read a stored expected output

limitations: The retained substrate is a synthetic source-free fixture; a source-free fixture result cannot establish live occupancy.
The fresh-process replay runs on the same host interpreter; it is not a cross-machine or cross-version replay proof.
No new semantic, comparability or model authority is created by the grade contract.
